title.tr: Dağ Silüetli Metal Duvar Askılığı 5 Kancalı 60x20 cm Dekoratif Portmanto

description.tr:
Evinizin girişine hem dekoratif hem de kullanışlı bir dokunuş katmak için tasarlanan Dağ Silüetli Metal Duvar Askılığı, doğadan ilham alan dağ ve çam ağacı tasarımıyla bulunduğu ortama modern bir görünüm kazandırır.

60 cm genişliğindeki yapısı sayesinde mont, ceket, çanta, şapka, anahtar ve benzeri günlük eşyalarınızı düzenli şekilde asabilmeniz için geniş bir kullanım alanı sunar. Üzerinde bulunan 5 adet askı kancası, farklı eşyaların aynı anda kullanılabilmesine olanak sağlar.

Metal gövdesi sayesinde sağlam ve uzun ömürlüdür. Duvara monte edilen tasarımı yer kaplamadan düzen sağlamaya yardımcı olur. Antre, koridor, yatak odası, ofis, çalışma odası veya benzeri alanlarda kullanılabilir.

Ürün Özellikleri

  • Ürün tipi: Dekoratif metal duvar askılığı
  • Tasarım: Dağ ve çam ağacı silüeti
  • Genişlik: 60 cm
  • Yükseklik: 20 cm
  • Kanca sayısı: 5 adet
  • Malzeme: Metal
  • Montaj tipi: Duvara monte
  • Kullanım alanı: Mont, ceket, şapka, çanta, anahtar ve günlük aksesuarlar
  • Renk seçenekleri: Siyah, Beyaz, Bordo, Gümüş ve Altın
  • İç ve kuru alan kullanımına uygundur.

Kullanım / Montaj Talimatı

Ürünü monte edeceğiniz duvar üzerinde uygun noktaları belirleyin. Duvar tipine uygun vida ve dübel kullanarak ürünü sabitleyin. Montaj tamamlandıktan sonra ürünün duvara sağlam şekilde oturduğundan emin olun. Ürünün taşıma kapasitesini aşacak kadar ağır eşyalar asmayınız.

title.tr: Duvara Monte Metal Şaraplık 5 Şişelik Ağaç Desenli Dekoratif Şişelik Bordo

description.tr:
The Refined Ağaç Desenli Duvara Monte Metal Şaraplık, şarap şişelerinizi düzenli biçimde saklarken yaşam alanınıza dekoratif bir görünüm kazandırmak için tasarlanmıştır. Fonksiyonel depolama alanını özel lazer kesim tasarımla birleştiren ürün; salon, mutfak, yemek odası, bar köşesi, kafe, restoran ve benzeri iç mekânlarda kullanılabilir.

Ön bölümünde yer alan detaylı ağaç ve dallar desenli lazer kesim panel, şaraplığı yalnızca bir saklama ürünü olmaktan çıkararak dekorasyonun dikkat çekici bir parçası haline getirir. Bordo rengi ve metal yüzeyi sayesinde klasik, modern ve endüstriyel dekorasyon stilleriyle rahatlıkla uyum sağlar. Dikey formu, duvar alanını verimli kullanmaya yardımcı olur ve özellikle zeminde ekstra alan kaplamak istemeyen kullanıcılar için pratik bir çözüm sunar.

Ürün toplam 5 adet şarap şişesini yatay konumda saklayabilecek şekilde tasarlanmıştır. Şişelerin yatay yerleşimi hem düzenli bir görünüm sağlar hem de farklı şişelere kolayca ulaşmanıza imkân tanır. Duvara monte edilen yapısı sayesinde şarap koleksiyonunuzu sergilemek için şık ve düzenli bir alan oluşturur.

Şaraplık 2 mm çelik sacdan üretilmektedir. Metal parçalar lazer kesim yöntemiyle işlenerek ağaç desenindeki ince detayların net ve estetik görünmesi sağlanır. Ürün yüzeyi elektrostatik toz boya ile kaplanmıştır. Bu kaplama, metal yüzeye düzgün bir görünüm kazandırırken günlük kullanıma uygun, dayanıklı bir yüzey oluşturur.

Ürünün ölçüleri 70 cm yükseklik, 20 cm genişlik ve 12 cm derinliktir. İnce ve dikey yapısı sayesinde dar duvar alanlarında da kullanılabilir. Mutfak tezgâhlarının üzerindeki boş duvarlarda, yemek odalarında, salonlarda veya özel olarak hazırlanan şarap köşelerinde dekoratif bir tamamlayıcı olarak tercih edilebilir.

Montaj işlemi duvar üzerinden yapılır. Ürünün sağlam ve güvenli şekilde kullanılabilmesi için paket içerisinde 4 adet vida ve 4 adet dübel gönderilmektedir. Montaj öncesinde uygulanacak duvarın yapısının ürün ve şişelerin toplam ağırlığını taşıyabilecek durumda olduğundan emin olunması önerilir.

Ürün özellikleri:

  • Ölçü: 20 × 70 × 12 cm
  • Kapasite: 5 şişe
  • Malzeme: 2 mm çelik sac
  • Üretim yöntemi: Lazer kesim
  • Yüzey: Elektrostatik toz boya
  • Renk: Bordo
  • Tasarım: Dekoratif ağaç deseni
  • Kullanım şekli: Duvara monte
  • Paket içeriği: 1 adet metal şaraplık, 4 adet vida, 4 adet dübel
  • Üretim yeri: Türkiye

Temizlik sırasında ürünün yüzeyini korumak için yumuşak, hafif nemli bir bez kullanılması tavsiye edilir. Aşındırıcı süngerler, sert fırçalar ve güçlü kimyasal temizlik ürünleri metal yüzeye zarar verebileceğinden kullanılmamalıdır. Ürün taşınırken veya montaj yeri değiştirilirken şişelerin önceden çıkarılması gerekir.

Not: Ürün görsellerinde yer alan şarap şişeleri, bardaklar ve diğer dekoratif aksesuarlar görsel amaçlıdır ve paket içeriğine dahil değildir.

title.tr: Duvara Monte Metal Şaraplık 5 Şişelik Üzüm Desenli Dekoratif Şişelik

description.tr:
The Refined Üzüm Desenli Metal Şaraplık, şarap koleksiyonunuzu hem düzenli saklamak hem de yaşam alanınıza dekoratif bir görünüm kazandırmak için tasarlanmıştır.

Lazer kesim üzüm ve asma yaprağı deseni sayesinde klasik bir şişelikten farklı olarak duvar dekorasyonunun bir parçası haline gelir. Dikey tasarımı sayesinde fazla yer kaplamadan 5 adet şarap şişesini yatay şekilde taşıyabilir.

Ürün 2 mm çelik sacdan lazer kesim yöntemiyle üretilir ve dayanıklı elektrostatik toz boya ile kaplanır. Tek parça metal gövdesi sayesinde sağlam ve uzun ömürlü kullanım sunar.

Duvara monte edilen tasarımında bağlantı noktaları ürünün arkasında kalır. Böylece montaj sonrasında ön yüzde vida görüntüsü oluşmaz ve daha temiz bir görünüm elde edilir.

  • Ölçü: 20 × 70 × 12 cm
  • Yükseklik: 70 cm
  • Genişlik: 20 cm
  • Derinlik: 12 cm
  • Kapasite: 5 şişe
  • Malzeme: 2 mm çelik sac
  • Üretim: Lazer kesim
  • Boya: Elektrostatik toz boya
  • Kullanım şekli: Duvara monte

  • Gövde: Tek parça metal
  • Üretim yeri: Türkiye

Salon, mutfak, yemek odası, bar bölümü, restoran, kafe veya şarap köşelerinde kullanılabilir. Dekoratif görünümü sayesinde şarap severler için hediye seçeneği olarak da uygundur.

Not: Görsellerde kullanılan şarap şişeleri ve diğer dekoratif aksesuarlar ürüne dahil değildir.

Bring warmth, elegance and artistic character to your space with this sun and woman metal wall art. The design combines a graceful female profile with sun rays and flowing abstract lines, creating a striking focal point for modern interiors.

title.en: Personalized Husky Name Sign, Custom Metal Dog Wall Art, Siberian Husky Pet Portrait
title.tr: Personalized Husky Name Sign, Custom Metal Dog Wall Art, Siberian Husky Pet Portrait

description.en:
Celebrate your Siberian Husky with a personalized Husky name sign created especially for your home. Featuring a detailed Husky portrait and your dog’s name, this laser-cut metal wall art makes a meaningful addition to an entryway, living room, pet corner or memorial space.

PERSONALIZED FOR YOUR DOG

Your chosen name is carefully integrated into the lower section of the design, creating one coordinated metal artwork. The surrounding oval frame, distinctive upright ears, facial markings and layered fur details capture the recognizable character of a Siberian Husky.

Please enter the name exactly as you would like it to appear. Capitalization will follow the text submitted with your order unless another preference is included in the personalization notes.

PRODUCT DETAILS

• Personalized Siberian Husky name sign
• Made from 2 mm sheet steel
• Precision CNC fiber laser-cut design
• One-piece connected metal construction
• Fine-textured matte black RAL 9005 powder-coated finish
• Clean, carefully finished laser-cut edges
• Designed with strong connecting bridges between the portrait, frame and lettering
• Suitable for living rooms, entryways, pet corners, bedrooms and home offices
• Physical metal wall decoration – this is not a digital download

AVAILABLE SIZES

Sizing is based on the overall HEIGHT of the artwork:

• 30 cm / 11.8 in
• 40 cm / 15.7 in
• 50 cm / 19.7 in
• 60 cm / 23.6 in
• 70 cm / 27.6 in
• 80 cm / 31.5 in
• 90 cm / 35.4 in
• 100 cm / 39.4 in
• 110 cm / 43.3 in
• 120 cm / 47.2 in
• 130 cm / 51.2 in
• 140 cm / 55.1 in
• 150 cm / 59.1 in

The width is proportional to the selected height and is approximately 76% of the height. Slight dimensional differences may occur because longer or shorter names can require minor spacing adjustments.

HOW TO PERSONALIZE

1. Select your preferred size.
2. Enter your dog’s name in the personalization box.
3. Check the spelling carefully before submitting your order.
4. If you need special capitalization or have another request, include it with the name.

Personalization example:

LUNA
MAX
KODA

Please submit one name per sign. The personalization preview image shows separate name examples and does not represent a three-piece set.

A THOUGHTFUL GIFT

This personalized Husky wall art makes a thoughtful gift for:

• Siberian Husky owners
• Dog lovers and pet parents
• New puppy celebrations
• Birthdays and housewarmings
• Pet adoption anniversaries
• Husky memorial spaces
• Christmas and special occasions

FINISH AND APPEARANCE

The primary finish is matte black. Its neutral color creates a clear contrast against ivory, beige, gray, blue and natural stone walls.

The lifestyle photographs demonstrate possible styling and scale. Furniture, plants, bowls, dog beds and other decorative objects shown in the photographs are not included.

INSTALLATION

The artwork is designed for wall display with concealed spacing behind the product, creating a subtle shadow and dimensional appearance. Installation requirements may vary depending on the size selected and your wall type.

Please use mounting components suitable for your wall material and selected product size. If you are unsure which fittings to use, consult a qualified installer.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

• Dust gently with a clean, soft and dry cloth.
• Avoid abrasive cleaners and rough sponges.
• Do not bend the narrow portrait or lettering details.
• Keep the product away from prolonged contact with moisture unless outdoor suitability has been confirmed for your order.

IMPORTANT PERSONALIZATION INFORMATION

Because this item is made with the name you provide, please review the spelling before ordering. Personalized products cannot normally be resold after production has started.

Minor variations in surface texture and finish may occur as part of the metal cutting and powder-coating process. Screen settings and lighting conditions can also affect how the color appears.

Each sign is created specifically for the name submitted with the order.

description.en:
Add practical storage and botanical character to your walls with this minimalist metal wall shelf.

Crafted from 2 mm steel, the shelf features delicate laser-cut leaf details on both sides and a clean matte black powder-coated finish. Its simple silhouette works beautifully in living rooms, bedrooms, entryways, offices and reading corners.

PRODUCT DETAILS

• Material: 2 mm steel
• Finish: Matte black powder coating
• Width: 60 cm / 23.6 in
• Height: 20 cm / 7.9 in
• Depth: 20 cm / 7.9 in
• Botanical laser-cut design
• Folded single-piece steel construction
• Four mounting points

title.en: Minimalist Black Steel Christmas Tree Wall Art, Modern Holiday Decor
title.tr: Minimalist Black Steel Christmas Tree Wall Art, Modern Holiday Decor

description.en:
Christmas Tree Metal Wall Art
Bring a clean, modern touch to your holiday decorating with this Christmas Tree Metal Wall Art, crafted from precision laser-cut steel and finished in an elegant matte black powder coating.
The circular Christmas tree silhouette combines traditional holiday symbolism with a minimalist contemporary design, making it easy to style in modern, Scandinavian, farmhouse, rustic, or neutral interiors.
Unlike temporary seasonal decorations, this steel wall art is designed to be reused year after year and become part of your family's Christmas decorating tradition.
PRODUCT DETAILS
• Material: Premium mild steel
• Thickness: Approximately 2 mm
• Manufacturing: Precision CNC laser cut
• Finish: Matte black electrostatic powder coating
• Design: Christmas tree inside a circular frame
• Construction: Durable one-piece metal design
• Style: Minimalist / Modern / Scandinavian / Christmas
• Installation: Designed for easy wall mounting
• Suitable for indoor use
• Carefully finished for smooth, clean edges
The matte black finish creates beautiful contrast against beige, ivory, white, greige, stone, and warm neutral walls.
AVAILABLE SIZES

• 30 cm / 11.8 in
• 40 cm / 15.7 in
• 50 cm / 19.7 in
• 60 cm / 23.6 in

• 80 cm / 31.5 in

PERFECT FOR
This Christmas metal wall decoration works beautifully in:
• Living rooms
• Entryways
• Above fireplaces
• Dining rooms
• Hallways
• Bedrooms
• Christmas display areas
• Holiday-themed offices
• Scandinavian interiors
• Modern farmhouse interiors
• Neutral Christmas decor
It can also make a thoughtful seasonal gift for family, friends, new homeowners, Christmas lovers, and anyone who prefers elegant holiday decor instead of traditional colorful decorations.
PREMIUM METAL CONSTRUCTION
Each piece is precision cut from steel to create clean lines and a strong silhouette.
The matte powder-coated surface provides a refined, low-gloss appearance while also helping protect the metal surface.
The product is not printed, vinyl, plastic, MDF, or wooden wall decor.
It is a real steel wall decoration.
EASY TO INSTALL
The artwork is designed for straightforward wall installation.
Depending on the selected size and wall type, appropriate mounting hardware should be used.
A small spacing between the artwork and the wall can create the subtle dimensional shadow shown in our photographs.
HANDMADE CHARACTER
Each item is produced and finished individually.
Minor variations associated with metal cutting, powder coating, or handmade production may occur and are part of the character of the product.
PACKAGING
Your wall art is carefully protected and packaged for international transportation.
Larger sizes require reinforced packaging because of their dimensions and the characteristics of sheet metal products.
PLEASE NOTE
• Colors can appear slightly different depending on screen settings and lighting.
• Lifestyle photographs are intended to demonstrate possible placement and scale.
• Please select your preferred size from the variation menu before ordering.
• The listing includes the metal wall artwork only unless otherwise stated.
• Decorative furniture, candles, garlands, gifts, and accessories shown in photographs are not included.
MADE FOR CHRISTMAS, DESIGNED TO LAST
Simple enough for contemporary interiors and recognizable enough to instantly bring a Christmas atmosphere into the room, this metal Christmas tree is designed to become a seasonal piece you can display year after year.

title.en: Leo Zodiac Metal Wall Art – Crowned Lion Decor
title.tr: Leo Zodiac Metal Wall Art – Crowned Lion Decor

description.en:
🦁 Guardian of Courage

Every great achievement begins with a single decision: the courage to take the first step.

The lion has long been a symbol of courage, confidence, and leadership. In this artwork, every detail was designed with intention.

The flowing mane represents the energy of the sun.
The hidden Leo constellation and the subtle zodiac symbol are quiet details waiting to be discovered.
The lion looks toward the horizon—not in search of a fight, but toward the next challenge.

This piece doesn't promise luck.

It serves as a daily reminder that courage isn't something you find one day.

It's something you choose, again and again.

✨"The artwork doesn't create courage. It reminds you that it has always been there."


Product Features & Details
Material & Craftsmanship: Precision laser-cut from high-quality 2 mm premium steel sheet for crisp, clean edges.

Durable Finish: Electrostatic powder coating applied for high resistance against rust, fading, and scratches.

Indoor & Outdoor Safe: Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, offices, entryway walls, or covered outdoor areas.

Thoughtful Astrology Gift: An ideal gift for Leo season, birthdays, housewarmings, or zodiac enthusiasts.

title.en: Floral Metal Wall Shelf, 2-Tier Bendable Plant Display
title.tr: Floral Metal Wall Shelf, 2-Tier Bendable Plant Display

description.en:
Turn an empty wall into a functional floral display with this two-tier metal wall shelf.

Laser-cut from a single sheet of steel, the shelf arrives flat for compact and secure shipping. Simply bend the two integrated semicircular shelf sections outward to approximately 90°, mount the back panel, and style it with your favorite small plants, books, candles, skincare products, or decorative objects.

The floral and leaf details remain part of the flat back panel, creating an elegant botanical appearance while the two integrated shelves provide practical display space. Its arched silhouette works beautifully in modern, minimalist, boho, and Scandinavian-inspired interiors.

PRODUCT DETAILS

• Approximate overall size: 60 cm H × 20 cm W / 23.6 × 7.9 in
• Shelf depth after bending: 15 cm / 5.9 in
• Two integrated semicircular shelves
• Material: Laser-cut steel
• Finish: Electrostatic powder coating
• One-piece design with no separate shelf pieces
• Four wall-mounting holes
• Designed and made in Türkiye
• Recommended for indoor use

COLOR OPTIONS

• Matte Black
• Matte White
• Green
• Metallic Silver
• Yellow

Colors may appear slightly different depending on lighting and screen settings.

WHAT IS INCLUDED

• 1 × floral metal wall shelf, shipped flat
• 4 × screws
• 4 × wall plugs

Plants, books, candles, toiletries, and other decorative objects shown in the photos are not included.

EASY INSTALLATION

Place the shelf on a clean, padded surface.
Slowly bend only the two semicircular shelf sections outward until they reach approximately 90°.
Hold the back panel against the wall and mark the four mounting points.
Install suitable wall plugs and secure the shelf with the screws.
Add your favorite small, lightweight decorative objects.

Important: Bend each shelf slowly and only as needed. Repeatedly folding the metal back and forth may weaken it. Do not bend the floral or leaf sections.

The included fixings may not be suitable for every wall type. Please use mounting hardware appropriate for your wall and consult a professional if you are unsure.

PERFECT FOR

• Small indoor plants and succulents
• Books, candles, and framed miniatures
• Bathroom skincare and rolled hand towels
• Nursery and kids’ room decorations
• Entryways, bedrooms, living rooms, and home offices
• Housewarming, birthday, or new-home gifts

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

Wipe with a soft, slightly damp cloth and dry immediately. Do not use abrasive cleaners or leave the product exposed to standing water. Indoor use is recommended.

PROCESSING & SHIPPING

Each piece is prepared and powder-coated to order. Suggested processing time is 3–5 business days.

The shelf is shipped flat to help protect its shape during transit. Tracking is provided where supported by the carrier. International buyers are responsible for any customs duties or import taxes charged by their country.

CUSTOM REQUESTS

Need a different color or size? Please send us a message before ordering so we can confirm availability and pricing.

title.en: Melting Metal Shelf Set, Dripping Floating Shelves, 3 Piece Wall Shelf
title.tr: Melting Metal Shelf Set, Dripping Floating Shelves, 3 Piece Wall Shelf

description.en:
Turn everyday wall storage into a sculptural focal point with this three-piece melting metal shelf set. Each shelf features a distinctive flowing lower edge with softly rounded drips, creating the illusion that the metal is slowly melting down the wall.

The coordinated set includes small, medium and large shelves with complementary—but non-identical—silhouettes. Their straight upper surfaces provide practical display space, while the fluid front profiles add a bold contemporary character to living rooms, bedrooms, home offices, entryways and creative spaces.

Each shelf is precision laser-cut from 2 mm sheet metal, formed with controlled bends and finished with an electrostatic powder coating.

PRODUCT DETAILS

• Three-piece wall shelf set
• Includes small, medium and large shelves
• Made from 2 mm sheet metal
• Precision laser-cut flowing contours
• Bent and form-controlled construction
• Electrostatic powder-coated finish
• Straight functional shelf surfaces
• Rounded melting and dripping design
• Primary color shown: Black

AVAILABLE COLORS

• Black
• White
• Silver
• Gold
• Green
• Burgundy

Silver and gold are powder-coat colors and are not mirror-polished or made from precious metal.

• Contemporary, industrial and eclectic interiors

title.en: Elevated Dog Bowl Stand, Double Bowl Holder
title.tr: Elevated Dog Bowl Stand, Double Bowl Holder

description.en:
Create a stylish and dedicated feeding area for your dog with this elevated double-bowl metal feeder.

Featuring a friendly laser-cut dog silhouette and decorative paw-print details, this modern feeding station combines everyday function with a playful, pet-inspired design.

title.tr: Dağ Silüetli Metal Duvar Askılığı 5 Kancalı 60x20 cm Dekoratif Portmanto

description.tr:
Evinizin girişine hem dekoratif hem de kullanışlı bir dokunuş katmak için tasarlanan Dağ Silüetli Metal Duvar Askılığı, doğadan ilham alan dağ ve çam ağacı tasarımıyla bulunduğu ortama modern bir görünüm kazandırır.

60 cm genişliğindeki yapısı sayesinde mont, ceket, çanta, şapka, anahtar ve benzeri günlük eşyalarınızı düzenli şekilde asabilmeniz için geniş bir kullanım alanı sunar. Üzerinde bulunan 5 adet askı kancası, farklı eşyaların aynı anda kullanılabilmesine olanak sağlar.

Metal gövdesi sayesinde sağlam ve uzun ömürlüdür. Duvara monte edilen tasarımı yer kaplamadan düzen sağlamaya yardımcı olur. Antre, koridor, yatak odası, ofis, çalışma odası veya benzeri alanlarda kullanılabilir.

Ürün Özellikleri

  • Ürün tipi: Dekoratif metal duvar askılığı
  • Tasarım: Dağ ve çam ağacı silüeti
  • Genişlik: 60 cm
  • Yükseklik: 20 cm
  • Kanca sayısı: 5 adet
  • Malzeme: Metal
  • Montaj tipi: Duvara monte
  • Kullanım alanı: Mont, ceket, şapka, çanta, anahtar ve günlük aksesuarlar
  • Renk seçenekleri: Siyah, Beyaz, Bordo, Gümüş ve Altın
  • İç ve kuru alan kullanımına uygundur.

Kullanım / Montaj Talimatı

Ürünü monte edeceğiniz duvar üzerinde uygun noktaları belirleyin. Duvar tipine uygun vida ve dübel kullanarak ürünü sabitleyin. Montaj tamamlandıktan sonra ürünün duvara sağlam şekilde oturduğundan emin olun. Ürünün taşıma kapasitesini aşacak kadar ağır eşyalar asmayınız.

Temizlik için hafif nemli ve yumuşak bir bez kullanılması önerilir. Aşındırıcı kimyasallar, sert süngerler ve metal yüzeyi çizebilecek temizlik malzemeleri kullanılmamalıdır.

title.tr: Dağ Silüetli Metal Duvar Askılığı 5 Kancalı 60x20 cm Dekoratif Portmanto

description.tr:
Evinizin girişine hem dekoratif hem de kullanışlı bir dokunuş katmak için tasarlanan Dağ Silüetli Metal Duvar Askılığı, doğadan ilham alan dağ ve çam ağacı tasarımıyla bulunduğu ortama modern bir görünüm kazandırır.

60 cm genişliğindeki yapısı sayesinde mont, ceket, çanta, şapka, anahtar ve benzeri günlük eşyalarınızı düzenli şekilde asabilmeniz için geniş bir kullanım alanı sunar. Üzerinde bulunan 5 adet askı kancası, farklı eşyaların aynı anda kullanılabilmesine olanak sağlar.

Metal gövdesi sayesinde sağlam ve uzun ömürlüdür. Duvara monte edilen tasarımı yer kaplamadan düzen sağlamaya yardımcı olur. Antre, koridor, yatak odası, ofis, çalışma odası veya benzeri alanlarda kullanılabilir.

Ürün Özellikleri

  • Ürün tipi: Dekoratif metal duvar askılığı
  • Tasarım: Dağ ve çam ağacı silüeti
  • Genişlik: 60 cm
  • Yükseklik: 20 cm
  • Kanca sayısı: 5 adet
  • Malzeme: Metal
  • Montaj tipi: Duvara monte
  • Kullanım alanı: Mont, ceket, şapka, çanta, anahtar ve günlük aksesuarlar
  • Renk seçenekleri: Siyah, Beyaz, Bordo, Gümüş ve Altın
  • İç ve kuru alan kullanımına uygundur.

Kullanım / Montaj Talimatı

Ürünü monte edeceğiniz duvar üzerinde uygun noktaları belirleyin. Duvar tipine uygun vida ve dübel kullanarak ürünü sabitleyin. Montaj tamamlandıktan sonra ürünün duvara sağlam şekilde oturduğundan emin olun. Ürünün taşıma kapasitesini aşacak kadar ağır eşyalar asmayınız.

Temizlik için hafif nemli ve yumuşak bir bez kullanılması önerilir. Aşındırıcı kimyasallar, sert süngerler ve metal yüzeyi çizebilecek temizlik malzemeleri kullanılmamalıdır.

title.tr: Yaprak Desenli Metal Kitaplık 180x70x25 cm Modern Dekoratif Raf Ünitesi

description.tr:
Modern tasarımı ve dekoratif yaprak desenli yan panelleriyle yaşam alanlarınıza şık bir görünüm kazandıran metal kitaplık, kitaplarınızı, bitkilerinizi ve dekoratif objelerinizi düzenli bir şekilde sergilemeniz için tasarlanmıştır.

180 x 70 x 25 cm ölçülerindeki ürün, tamamen metal gövdesi sayesinde sağlam bir yapıya sahiptir. Yan bölümlerde bulunan lazer kesim desenler ürüne klasik kitaplıklardan farklı, dekoratif bir görünüm kazandırır. İnce ve dikey formu sayesinde fazla yer kaplamadan yüksek depolama alanı sunar.

Salon, çalışma odası, yatak odası, ofis, mağaza ve benzeri iç mekanlarda; kitaplık, dekoratif raf, bitki standı veya çok amaçlı düzenleyici olarak kullanılabilir.

Metal yüzey statik toz boya ile kaplanmıştır. Farklı renk seçenekleri sayesinde bulunduğu ortama ve dekorasyon tarzınıza uygun rengi tercih edebilirsiniz.

Ürün Özellikleri

  • Ölçü: 180 x 70 x 25 cm
  • Malzeme: Metal
  • Yüzey: Statik toz boya
  • Tasarım: Lazer kesim yaprak desenli yan paneller
  • Kullanım alanı: Salon, çalışma odası, yatak odası, ofis ve iç mekanlar
  • Kullanım amacı: Kitap, bitki ve dekoratif objelerin sergilenmesi
  • Ürün demonte olarak gönderilir.
  • Montaj için gerekli bağlantı elemanları paket içerisinde yer alır.


Renk Seçenekleri:
Siyah, Beyaz, Gümüş, Sarı, Mavi, Yeşil ve Kırmızı.


Dekoratif görünümü ile yalnızca bir depolama ürünü değil, aynı zamanda bulunduğu ortamın tasarımını tamamlayan modern bir mobilya parçasıdır.

title.en: Trick or Treat Metal Wall Art, Halloween Wall Decor, Laser Cut Steel Sign, Spooky Halloween Home Decor
title.tr: Trick or Treat Metal Wall Art, Halloween Wall Decor, Laser Cut Steel Sign, Spooky Halloween Home Decor

description.en:
Product Description
Bring a bold Halloween atmosphere to your home with this Trick or Treat Metal Wall Art. Precision laser-cut from durable steel and finished with a matte black powder coating, this Halloween wall decor adds a stylish spooky touch to living rooms, entryways, porches, doors, and seasonal displays.
Featuring an intricate “TRICK OR TREAT” design with Halloween-inspired details, this metal sign combines spooky seasonal character with a clean, elegant look that works beautifully with modern, rustic, farmhouse, gothic, and contemporary interiors.
Each piece is designed to create striking wall presence while remaining lightweight, durable, and easy to display.
DETAILS
• Material: Premium sheet steel
• Production: Precision laser cut
• Finish: Matte black electrostatic powder coating
• Color: Matte Black
• Suitable for indoor and covered outdoor use
• Durable and long-lasting metal construction
• Clean, detailed laser-cut design
• Handmade / made to order
• Multiple size options available
AVAILABLE SIZES
• 30 cm / 11.8 in
• 40 cm / 15.7 in
• 50 cm / 19.7 in
• 60 cm / 23.6 in
• 70 cm / 27.6 in
• 80 cm / 31.5 in
• 90 cm / 35.4 in
• 100 cm / 39.4 in
• 110 cm / 43.3 in
• 120 cm / 47.2 in
• 130 cm / 51.2 in
• 140 cm / 55.1 in
• 150 cm / 59.1 in
Please note: The selected size refers to the approximate width of the artwork. Height changes proportionally according to the original design.
PERFECT FOR
• Halloween home decor
• Living room wall decor
• Entryway decoration
• Front door or porch styling
• Halloween party decoration
• Gothic home decor
• Seasonal autumn decor
• Halloween gifts
• Haunted-house-inspired interiors
PREMIUM METAL FINISH
The artwork is produced from real sheet steel rather than plastic, wood, or printed material. The precision laser-cut edges and matte black powder-coated surface give the piece a clean, professional, and premium appearance.
Powder coating also provides a durable finish while preserving the subtle texture and authentic character of real metal.
EASY TO DISPLAY
The artwork is designed for easy wall installation. Depending on your wall surface and preferred installation method, suitable mounting hardware can be used to securely display the piece.
PLEASE NOTE
Because each item is individually manufactured, very small variations in the surface or finish may naturally occur and are part of the character of a real manufactured metal product.
Colors may also appear slightly different depending on screen settings and lighting.
Add a unique Halloween statement to your space with a handcrafted Trick or Treat metal wall sign designed to be enjoyed season after season.

title.en: Personalized Fishing Metal Wall Art, Custom Angler Lodge Sign (Laser Cut)
title.tr: Personalized Fishing Metal Wall Art, Custom Angler Lodge Sign (Laser Cut)

description.en:
Create a personalized centerpiece for your fishing cabin, lake house or angler's room with this detailed Fishing Metal Wall Art sign.
Featuring a powerful game fish surrounded by a classic fishing net, rod and reel details, this custom metal sign combines vintage sporting-club aesthetics with modern laser-cut craftsmanship.
The center banner can be personalized with a family name, cabin name, fishing club name or other custom wording, while the established year and lower text can be adapted to create a truly personal piece.
The sample design features:
GARRISON
EST. 1928
FINE ANGLING
Perfect for lake houses, fishing cabins, boathouses, lodges, man caves, home offices and outdoor-inspired interiors.
PERSONALIZATION
You can customize:
Main Name / Text
Example: GARRISON
Established Year
Example: EST. 1928
Bottom Text
Example: FINE ANGLING
Other examples:
MILLER
EST. 1986
FISHING LODGE
or
PINE LAKE
EST. 2004
ANGLERS CLUB
Please enter all text exactly as you want it to appear, including capitalization and year.
PRODUCT DETAILS
Material: Steel
Thickness: 2 mm
Production: Precision laser cut
Finish: Powder coated
Standard Color: Matte Black
Style: Fishing / Lake House / Rustic / Lodge
Design: Fish, fishing net, rod, reel and personalized lettering
Made to Order: Yes
The detailed negative-space construction creates the scales, fins, fishing net and equipment while keeping the overall artwork connected as a single metal composition.
Its raised wall installation creates subtle natural shadows behind the artwork for additional depth.

FINISH OPTIONS
The visual set supports three strong color concepts:
Matte Black — classic and versatile
Forest Green — ideal for fishing and lake-house interiors
Muted Bronze — warm vintage lodge appearance
These three colors fit this product particularly well.
PERFECT FOR
Fishing cabins, lake houses, boathouses, lodges, man caves, offices, home bars, fishing clubs and rustic interiors.
It also makes a meaningful gift for fishermen, anglers, dads, husbands, grandfathers, cabin owners and anyone passionate about fishing.
CARE

PLEASE NOTE
Please review all personalized text carefully before ordering. Personalized items are produced according to the exact information submitted with the order.
Screen settings and lighting may cause slight variations in the appearance of colors.

title.tr: Nativity Scene Metal Wall Art, Christian Christmas Decor, Holy Family Manger Sign

description.en:
Bring the peaceful spirit of Christmas into your home with this Nativity Scene Metal Wall Art.

The design depicts Mary and Joseph kneeling beside the infant Jesus beneath the Star of Bethlehem. The rustic stable silhouette and flowing ground lines create an elegant focal point while allowing the color and texture of your wall to become part of the composition.

Its timeless religious design complements modern, farmhouse, traditional, minimalist, and devotional interiors. Display it in a living room, entryway, dining room, prayer corner, church, office, or seasonal Christmas arrangement.

• Holy Family nativity scene  
• Mary, Joseph, infant Jesus, manger, stable, and Star of Bethlehem  
• Precision laser-cut metal construction  
• Approximately 2 mm sheet steel  
• Fine-textured powder-coated finish  
• Designed as one coordinated wall decoration  
• Suitable for Christmas and year-round devotional display  
• Made to order

title.tr: Personalized Bar Sign Metal Wall Art, Custom Family Name Whiskey Barrel Decor, Home Bar, Pub or Man Cave Gift

description.en:
Create a bar space that feels unmistakably yours with a personalized whiskey barrel metal sign featuring your family name, bar name, and established year. The barrel-inspired silhouette, bold serif lettering, and symmetrical grain details bring a refined pub character to home bars, whiskey rooms, offices, garages, restaurants, tasting rooms, and man caves.

Each sign is cut from one flat sheet of 2 mm steel and finished with a fine-textured matte powder coat. The open-cut design lets the wall show through the barrel framework, creating a clean silhouette and a subtle shadow when displayed with wall separation.

PERSONALIZATION

The sample reads:

THE CARTER BAR
EST. 2020

Your sign can be personalized with:

Family name or bar name

Optional top line such as “THE”

Optional lower word such as “BAR,” “PUB,” “GARAGE,” or “OFFICE”

Established year

Please enter the wording exactly as you would like it produced. Capitalization will follow your submitted text unless a design adjustment is required for readability. A digital layout preview should be sent before production for unusually long names or wording.

PRODUCT DETAILS

Material: 2 mm sheet steel

Production: precision laser cut

Finish: fine-textured matte black powder coat

Construction: one continuous flat metal design

Style: whiskey barrel, pub, industrial, rustic and modern

Display: indoor wall decor

Sizes: 30–150 cm, measured along the longest outside dimension

Handmade to order

SIZE OPTIONS

30 cm / 11.8 in

40 cm / 15.7 in

50 cm / 19.7 in

60 cm / 23.6 in

70 cm / 27.6 in

80 cm / 31.5 in

90 cm / 35.4 in

100 cm / 39.4 in

110 cm / 43.3 in

120 cm / 47.2 in

130 cm / 51.2 in

140 cm / 55.1 in

150 cm / 59.1 in

Because the design is nearly circular, the stated size refers to its longest overall outside measurement, including the decorative grain branches. The other dimension follows the artwork’s fixed proportions.

IDEAL FOR

Home bars and whiskey rooms

Commercial bars, pubs and tasting rooms

Industrial offices and reception areas

Garages, workshops and man caves

Anniversary, housewarming and bar-owner gifts

Personalized family-name decor

PLEASE NOTE

Listing photos show styled examples; surrounding furniture, bottles and accessories are not included.

Colors may appear slightly different because of lighting and screen settings.

Very long names may require smaller lettering or a layout adjustment.

Review all spelling, capitalization and year details before placing the order.

Custom-made items cannot normally be returned for spelling or date information submitted incorrectly by the buyer.

If you need a different word arrangement, business name, or custom size, message TheRefinedWallArt before ordering.

title.en: Halloween Haunted House Metal Door Sign
title.tr: Halloween Haunted House Metal Door Sign

description.en:
Add a spooky and stylish touch to your home this Halloween with this laser-cut metal Halloween door sign.

Featuring a haunted house, bats, spooky trees, jack-o’-lanterns and a bold “Happy Halloween” design, this round metal decoration is perfect for front doors, porches, entryways, walls and seasonal Halloween displays.

Made from durable sheet metal and precisely cut with laser technology, it is designed to be a long-lasting Halloween decoration you can use year after year.

Product Features:

Laser-cut metal construction
Durable and sturdy design
Black powder-coated finish
Suitable for front doors, porches and walls
Haunted house, bat and pumpkin details
Great for Halloween home décor
Reusable seasonal decoration
Suitable for indoor and covered outdoor use

The clean black silhouette creates a strong contrast on white, beige, wood and colored doors, making it especially eye-catching as a front-door decoration.

A great Halloween gift for homeowners, Halloween lovers, families and anyone who enjoys spooky seasonal decorations.

Please note: Colors may appear slightly different depending on screen settings and lighting.

title.en: Gothic Haunted House Metal Wall Art, Spooky Mansion Decor, Halloween Wall Hanging
title.tr: Gothic Haunted House Metal Wall Art, Spooky Mansion Decor, Halloween Wall Hanging

description.en:
Bring a haunting gothic atmosphere to your space with this Gothic Haunted House Metal Wall Art, featuring a mysterious Victorian-style mansion framed inside a dramatic arched gothic window. Bats, a crescent moon, twisted trees and intricate architectural details create a striking silhouette designed for Halloween interiors, gothic homes and dark academia spaces.
Crafted from 2 mm steel and precision laser cut as a single connected piece, this wall art combines detailed design with a clean, durable construction. The matte black powder-coated finish creates a bold contrast against light or colored walls, while the offset mounting style produces a subtle shadow for added depth.
PRODUCT DETAILS
• Material: 2 mm steel
• Manufacturing: Precision CNC laser cut
• Construction: Single-piece connected metal design
• Finish: Matte Black Powder Coat
• Color: RAL 9005 Black
• Mounting style: Hidden / approximately 15 mm wall offset
• Orientation: Vertical
• Designed for indoor wall display
• Made to order
• Available heights: 30 cm – 150 cm / 11.8" – 59.1"
DESIGN
The artwork combines a pointed gothic cathedral-style window with a haunted mansion, crescent moon, flying bats and bare twisted trees. Negative-space detailing gives the piece an architectural appearance while maintaining a dramatic silhouette from a distance.
Perfect for:
• Gothic home decor
• Halloween wall decor
• Dark academia interiors
• Haunted house themed rooms
• Entryways and hallways
• Reading rooms and libraries
• Bedrooms and living rooms
• Horror and spooky decor collections
• Unique Halloween gifts
SIZE INFORMATION
The selected size represents the overall HEIGHT of the artwork.
Approximate width is about 60% of the selected height because of the tall gothic-window proportions.
For example:
30 cm height ≈ 18 cm width
60 cm height ≈ 36 cm width
90 cm height ≈ 54 cm width
120 cm height ≈ 72 cm width
150 cm height ≈ 91 cm width
Minor dimensional differences may occur during production.
FINISH
The standard finish is a finely textured matte black powder coating, giving the steel a clean modern appearance while highlighting the detailed laser-cut silhouette.
INSTALLATION
The artwork is designed to sit slightly away from the wall, creating a soft dimensional shadow behind the design. Always use mounting hardware appropriate for your specific wall type.
CARE
For indoor use. Clean gently with a soft dry cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaners.
PLEASE NOTE
Furniture, candles, plants and other decorative objects shown in lifestyle images are not included.
Colors may appear slightly different depending on lighting and screen settings.
Each piece is made to order, so very small manufacturing variations may occur.
This original design was developed using AI-assisted creative tools and refined for physical laser-cut production.
Designed by TheRefinedWallArt.

title.en: Viking Raven Metal Wall Art, Nordic Compass and Longship Decor, Norse Mythology Wall Hanging, Viking Gift
title.tr: Viking Raven Metal Wall Art, Nordic Compass and Longship Decor, Norse Mythology Wall Hanging, Viking Gift

description.en:
Bring the spirit of the North into your space with Wayfinder's Gate, a striking Viking-inspired metal wall art design featuring a watchful raven, a Nordic compass, rugged mountain peaks and a longship sailing through stylized waves. Framed by an arched Celtic-knot border and crowned with a guiding star, the composition feels like a portal into an old northern saga.

Designed for Viking enthusiasts, Norse mythology lovers and anyone drawn to bold Scandinavian interiors, this vertical statement piece adds depth and character to a living room, entryway, office, study, reading nook, cabin or man cave. Its open-cut silhouette allows the wall color to become part of the artwork, while the hidden standoff mounting creates a subtle floating shadow.

PRODUCT DETAILS

Original Viking-inspired raven, compass, mountain and longship composition

Precision laser cut from one continuous sheet of 2 mm steel

Strong connected construction with no loose decorative pieces

Clean, carefully deburred edges

Durable electrostatic powder-coated finish

Matte Black is the classic finish; Muted Bronze and Matte Ivory are optional finish choices

Approximately 15 mm hidden wall standoff for a floating appearance and soft shadow

Vertical arched format

Made to order

Suitable for indoor display

AVAILABLE HEIGHTS

Choose from 30 cm to 150 cm (11.8–59.1 in). The selected size refers to the overall height of the artwork. Approximate proportional widths are listed in the size menu. Because every piece is made individually, a small dimensional tolerance may occur.

FINISH OPTIONS

Matte Black

Muted Bronze

Matte Ivory

Colors may appear slightly different depending on screen settings, lighting and wall color. The listing images showing alternate finishes are visual references; one artwork is included per order.

INSTALLATION

The artwork is designed to sit approximately 15 mm away from the wall, creating a refined floating effect. Installation hardware and instructions should be included only if they are part of your actual fulfilment package. For safe installation, use fixings appropriate for your wall material and the weight of the selected size.

MADE FOR DISTINCTIVE SPACES

Wayfinder's Gate works especially well as:

Viking or Norse-themed living room decor

A statement piece for a cabin, office, library or reading nook

Medieval, rustic, gothic or Scandinavian wall decor

A birthday, anniversary, housewarming or Father's Day gift

A gift for a husband, boyfriend, father, history enthusiast or Viking fan

PRODUCTION AND CARE

Each piece is laser cut, cleaned and powder coated for a smooth, durable finish. Wipe gently with a soft dry or slightly damp cloth. Do not use abrasive cleaners or scouring pads. Indoor use is recommended unless you specifically offer an exterior-grade coating.

IMPORTANT NOTES

This listing includes one metal wall artwork; furniture and decorative objects shown in lifestyle photographs are not included.

Lifestyle images are for presentation. Always check the selected dimensions before ordering.

Large sizes may require two people for safe installation.

The compass motif is a modern Nordic-inspired symbol commonly associated with wayfinding; this listing does not claim archaeological Viking-Age authenticity.

Buyers are responsible for checking any import taxes, customs duties or local charges that may apply in their country.

Questions about size, finish or installation are welcome. Send a message before ordering and we will help you choose the best option for your space.

title.en: Jesus Crucifix with Virgin Mary Metal Wall Art, Black Steel Christian Decor
title.tr: Jesus Crucifix with Virgin Mary Metal Wall Art, Black Steel Christian Decor

description.en:
Bring a powerful symbol of faith into your home with this Jesus Crucifix and Virgin Mary Metal Wall Art.

The design portrays Jesus on the cross with the Virgin Mary praying at the foot of the crucifix. Flowing robes, the crown of thorns, the wooden cross and the rocky ground are brought together in one expressive silhouette, creating a meaningful focal point for Christian and Catholic interiors.

Each piece is precision laser cut from a single sheet of 2 mm steel. The entire design is physically connected as one continuous metal artwork, then finished with a fine-textured matte black powder coating.

PRODUCT DETAILS

• Jesus Crucifix with the Virgin Mary
• Single-piece laser-cut steel construction
• 2 mm sheet steel
• Matte black powder-coated finish
• Clean, carefully finished edges
• Vertical orientation
• Suitable for living rooms, entryways, bedrooms, prayer rooms and devotional spaces
• Made to order
• Indoor wall decor

DISPLAY AND MOUNTING

The artwork is designed to sit slightly away from the wall, creating a soft natural shadow that adds depth to the silhouette. The appearance of the shadow may vary depending on the lighting and wall color.

title.en: Halloween Skull Metal Wall Art, Geometric Bat & Pumpkin Gothic Decor, Laser Cut Steel
title.tr: Halloween Skull Metal Wall Art, Geometric Bat & Pumpkin Gothic Decor, Laser Cut Steel

description.en:
Bring a bold gothic atmosphere to your Halloween decor with this geometric skull metal wall art. Featuring an angular skull surrounded by dramatic bat wings, spider-web details and two jack-o’-lantern pumpkins, this laser-cut steel design creates a striking seasonal focal point without relying on printed graphics or flat artwork.

Its open-cut silhouette allows the color and texture of your wall to become part of the design, creating depth and contrast while keeping the artwork visually clean and modern.

PRODUCT DETAILS

• Geometric Halloween skull metal wall art
• Skull, bat wings, spider webs and jack-o’-lantern pumpkin design
• Laser cut from a single connected sheet of steel
• 2 mm steel construction
• Matte black powder-coated finish
• Clean laser-cut edges
• Horizontal wall art layout
• Designed as a physical metal wall decoration
• Made to order
• Available in multiple sizes from 30 cm to 150 cm

SIZE OPTIONS

Choose the overall WIDTH of your artwork:

30 cm / 11.8 in
40 cm / 15.7 in
50 cm / 19.7 in
60 cm / 23.6 in
70 cm / 27.6 in
80 cm / 31.5 in
90 cm / 35.4 in
100 cm / 39.4 in
110 cm / 43.3 in
120 cm / 47.2 in
130 cm / 51.2 in
140 cm / 55.1 in
150 cm / 59.1 in

The selected measurement refers to the overall width of the artwork from its leftmost to rightmost point. Height scales proportionally with the design.

Please measure your available wall space before ordering. Lifestyle photographs should be used as styling references rather than exact size references.

DESIGN

The centerpiece is a sharp geometric skull with faceted lines and an aggressive gothic character. Large bat-inspired wings extend from both sides of the skull and incorporate spider-web details, while two carved Halloween pumpkins complete the lower part of the composition.

The result combines traditional Halloween imagery with a cleaner geometric metal-art style, making it suitable for both seasonal Halloween decorating and darker gothic interiors.

WHERE TO DISPLAY

This piece works especially well in:

• Living rooms
• Entryways and hallways
• Halloween-themed rooms
• Gothic interiors
• Home offices
• Entertainment rooms
• Above console tables or sideboards
• Seasonal Halloween displays

MATERIAL & FINISH

The artwork is produced from 2 mm steel using precision laser cutting and finished with a matte black powder coating.

The powder-coated surface gives the piece a clean, understated finish that contrasts especially well with beige, ivory, cream, warm gray, orange, terracotta and other autumn-inspired wall colors.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE

• 1 × Geometric Skull Halloween Metal Wall Art
• Size according to your selected variation

CARE

For indoor use, gently remove dust using a soft dry or slightly damp cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaning products that could damage the coated surface.

PLEASE NOTE

• Each size represents the overall width of the artwork.
• Height changes proportionally with width.
• Decorative items and furniture shown in lifestyle images are not included.
• Room scenes are intended to demonstrate styling and should not be used as precise scale references.
• Colors may appear slightly different depending on screen settings and lighting.

The detailed openwork composition creates a dramatic silhouette against the wall while maintaining the strong, balanced appearance of a traditional Viking shield.

PRODUCT DETAILS

• Product type: Physical metal wall art
• Material: 2 mm mild steel
• Finish: Matte black powder coating

STYLE AND PLACEMENT

This raven shield design works especially well in:

• Living rooms
• Home offices
• Entryways
• Bedrooms
• Gaming rooms
• Man caves
• Nordic or medieval-themed spaces
• Viking-inspired collections

INSTALLATION

The artwork does not include mounting hardware. Please choose screws, wall plugs, hooks or spacers suitable for your wall material and the final product weight.

For secure installation, especially on drywall or plasterboard, we recommend using correctly rated wall anchors or consulting a professional installer.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS

Clean gently with a dry, soft cloth. Do not use abrasive cleaners, chemical solvents or wet cloths. This version is intended for indoor use unless outdoor-grade coating is specifically confirmed before ordering.

MADE TO ORDER

Each piece is produced after the order is placed. The estimated production time is 5–7 business days before dispatch.

Because screen settings and lighting conditions differ, the physical powder-coated finish may appear slightly different from listing images.

• One Viking Shield metal wall decoration
• Decorative objects, furniture and mounting hardware shown in lifestyle images are not included

IMPORTANT DESIGN NOTE

The design may be adjusted slightly during production to strengthen very fine connections and ensure that all internal details remain securely connected in a single laser-cut metal piece. These technical adjustments will preserve the overall raven, shield and Nordic knotwork composition.

AI AND VISUALIZATION DISCLOSURE

Bring color, movement and natural elegance to your space with this set of four butterfly metal wall art panels. Each square panel features a different butterfly design, creating a coordinated gallery wall with beautiful variety and visual balance.

title.en: Custom Business Logo Metal Wall Sign
title.tr: Custom Business Logo Metal Wall Sign

description.en:
Turn your own business logo into a professional custom metal sign for a reception area, office, studio, cafe, barbershop, gym, clinic or retail space.

Your authorized logo file is reviewed and converted into a cut-ready design, precision laser cut from solid sheet metal and finished with electrostatic powder coating. The rigid construction gives the sign a strong, substantial feel, while the durable coating creates a smooth finish with improved resistance to everyday scratches, fading and wear.

This listing is designed for business owners who want a clean, physical brand feature rather than a lightweight printed sign.

Best file types

SVG, EPS, AI or vector PDF when available

High-resolution PNG with a transparent background

A sharp, high-contrast JPG if no vector file exists

How to order

Select your preferred size and color.

Upload the best available logo file or send it through Etsy Messages.

Include any notes about layout, symbol placement or details to remove.

I will check the logo for laser-cut suitability and prepare a production proof.

One reasonable revision is included. Cutting begins after written approval.

Important information

The selected size refers to the longest side of the complete logo. The other measurement follows the logo's proportions.

Very thin strokes, tiny lettering, gradients and complex shading may need to be simplified or removed.

Small bridges may be added inside letters and disconnected shapes so the sign remains secure.

Single-color, high-contrast logos generally produce the cleanest metal result.

If the supplied file is too small or unclear, a better file may be required.

Listing images show visual examples and mockups; your final sign will use your approved logo.

Powder-coat colors can appear slightly different under different screens and lighting.

Mounting requirements vary with the final design and size and should be confirmed before production.

By uploading a logo, you confirm that you own the trademark/artwork or are authorized by the owner to reproduce it. Unauthorized third-party brands, characters or protected designs cannot be produced.

Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth. Do not use abrasive cleaners. Designed primarily for indoor business spaces unless another use is agreed before ordering.

Personalization box

Enter the business name, preferred layout and any production notes. Confirm: “I own this logo or have permission to reproduce it.” Upload a vector file or high-resolution transparent PNG whenever possible.

description.en:
Turn your own car, motorcycle, truck, camper van or off-road vehicle into custom metal wall art built for a garage, office, man cave or living space.

The vehicle is redrawn from your photograph as a clean, cut-ready profile, precision laser cut from solid sheet metal and finished with electrostatic powder coating. The rigid metal construction feels strong and substantial, and the durable coating gives the piece a smooth surface with improved resistance to everyday scratches, fading and wear.

This personalized vehicle portrait makes a memorable gift for car lovers, motorcycle riders, collectors, new drivers, restoration enthusiasts and proud owners of a special vehicle.

Vehicles that work well

Classic, sports and modern cars

Motorcycles

Pickup trucks

Camper vans and RV-style vehicles

Off-road and 4x4 vehicles

Project cars and restored vehicles

How to order

Select the size and color.

Upload the clearest side or three-quarter vehicle photo available.

Tell me whether to keep or remove the background, license plate, driver and other details.

I will prepare a laser-cut design proof.

One reasonable revision is included, and production starts after approval.

Important information

The selected size is the longest side of the finished artwork. The other measurement follows the vehicle's proportions.

If the photo is too dark, blurry or obstructed, another image may be required.

Listing images are visual examples and mockups. Your finished artwork is created from your own vehicle.

By uploading a photo, you confirm that you own it or have permission to reproduce it. Manufacturer logos and other protected marks will be included only when you have the necessary rights.

Personalization box

Multi-generation family photos

Bring the timeless character of the Tudor Rose into your home with this laser-cut metal wall art, inspired by one of England’s most recognizable historic floral motifs.
The symmetrical rose at the center is surrounded by flowing botanical scrollwork and leaf details, creating a decorative piece that feels equally at home in traditional, medieval-inspired, English country, Gothic, cottage and eclectic interiors.

title.en: Custom Pet Portrait Metal Wall Art from Photo
title.tr: Custom Pet Portrait Metal Wall Art from Photo

description.en:
Turn a favorite pet photo into personalized metal wall art that celebrates the face, expression and character you love.

I convert your photo into a clean portrait designed specifically for laser cutting. The artwork is precision cut from solid sheet metal and finished with electrostatic powder coating for a smooth, durable surface. The rigid metal construction creates a substantial keepsake that is made to last far beyond an ordinary print.

This listing is suitable for dogs, cats, horses and many other pets. It can also be created as a two-pet portrait or a respectful pet memorial.

For the best result, send a photo with:

The pet's face and key features clearly visible

Good natural light and sharp focus

Minimal blur, filters or heavy shadows

Ears and head fully inside the frame

A front or three-quarter view whenever possible

How to order

Select your size and powder-coat color.

Upload your clearest pet photo or send it through Etsy Messages.

Include the pet's name and any details you want removed, such as the background, collar or leash.

I will prepare a cut-ready design proof for your approval.

One reasonable revision is included. The metal piece is produced after approval.

Important details

The selected size is measured along the longest side; the other dimension follows the portrait's proportions.

Fur, whiskers and very fine markings may be simplified so the design remains strong and suitable for laser cutting.

Tiny connecting bridges may be added to hold the design together securely.

If the original photo is not suitable, I may ask for another image before production.

Colors may vary slightly between screens and real powder-coated metal.

Listing images include visual examples and mockups; your portrait will be created from your own pet photo.

By uploading a photo, you confirm that you took it or have permission from the photographer to reproduce it.

Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth. Avoid abrasive cleaners and rough sponges. Designed primarily for indoor display.

Personalization box

Enter your pet's name, the number of pets and any details to remove. Confirm: “I own or have permission to use this photo.” Upload your clearest image or send it through Etsy Messages after purchase.
